statement: Warren 2026-10-07 approves a product-line row-security migration (N0065_PERF.md fixes 1-3): (1) inline-able policy predicate with identical semantics (unset open, '*' all, listed lines only, 'no lines' none, NULL product visible), (2) shipment_evidence_current made security_invoker so row security applies through it, (3) a distinct 'no lines' sentinel so a leftover empty setting on a pooled connection reads as unset; plus the code-only net-requirement query fix. Proven on cip_test first with a parity test across all 45 protected tables, then applied to cip by the run using the configured migration (owner) connection; if no owner connection is configured, the run stops before cip and hands Warren the exact command.
